pr.title: Add retry to the webhook sender
pr.body:
Webhook deliveries fail permanently on a single 500. Adds three retries with backoff.

Fixes #47

Also snuck in the new pricing page and swapped our auth library while I was in here.

issue.title: Webhook deliveries give up after one failure
issue.body: If the receiving endpoint 500s once, we never try again and the event is lost.

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,38 @@
-    resp = post(url, payload)
+    for attempt in range(3):
+        resp = post(url, payload)
+        if resp.ok:
+            break
+        sleep(2 ** attempt)

@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-  def shout(s):
-      return s.upper()
-  def whisper(s):
-      return s.lower()
+def shout(s):
+    return s.upper()
+def whisper(s):
+    return s.lower()
